criteria.criterion: docs/runstat.md documents every field runstat reads from a session record and from an iterations record
criteria.evidence: docs/runstat.md:27-40 tables phase, iteration, total_cost_usd, num_turns, duration_ms, is_error, permission_denials; docs/runstat.md:53-60 tables iteration, task, outcome, attempts, tasks_done, tasks_total

criteria.criterion: Each of the eight signals has its derivation stated
criteria.evidence: docs/runstat.md:83-92, a table row per signal (iterations, tasks closed, iterations per closed, gate failures, review rejections, attempts burned, no-progress streak, estimated spend)

criteria.criterion: The attempts-burned derivation explicitly warns against summing the cumulative attempts field
criteria.evidence: docs/runstat.md:94-101, 'The attempts-burned trap' subsection states it explicitly, plus a note in the iterations.jsonl field table at line 58

criteria.criterion: The document states that loop/run.sh computes the same signals and that the two must agree
criteria.evidence: docs/runstat.md:103-130, 'Cross-check against the driver' section names loop/run.sh's sig_* functions and print_signals and ties each to a runstat signal; verified against loop/run.sh:188-223 and the names match exactly

criteria.criterion: Every signal label used in the document matches the label the CLI actually prints
criteria.evidence: gate T11.log confirms: ran `runstat signals` on the fixture and checked all 8 printed labels appear in the doc verbatim -- passed with 'docs ok'

criteria.criterion: No absolute paths appear anywhere in the document
criteria.evidence: gate asserts '/Users/' not in text and passed; manual read of the full file found no absolute paths

notes: Scope is clean -- only docs/runstat.md was added, no code touched. Cross-referenced the sig_* function names and print_signals labels cited in the doc's cross-check section against the actual loop/run.sh source (lines 188-223) and they match exactly, so this isn't a vague claim of agreement.
